name: planning-with-intention
title_zh: 动手前先把方案摊开问过你再开工
tagline_zh: 需求有第二种读法、改错了又难回头的时候，它不急着敲代码，先把理解、边界和取舍摆出来让你点头，再动手。
tagline_en: When a request could be read two ways and a wrong guess is costly, it lays out its reading, scope and tradeoffs.
desc_en: Plan deliberately before acting. Use when the user asks you to build, change, design, migrate, or fix something whose shape is not yet settled, when a request has more than one reasonable interpretation, or when acting on a wrong reading would be expensive to undo.
why_zh: 它把「确认理解」当成必经步骤，而不是可跳过的客套；方案没对齐就不进入实现。
why_en: It treats confirming its reading as a required step, not a courtesy: no alignment, no implementation.
limit_zh: 只对「形状还没定」的任务生效：改个错别字、加个日志这类一眼到底的活儿它会直接做，不会先来问你；它也不替你拍板。
limit_en: Only kicks in when the task's shape is unsettled; trivial one-glance edits it just does. It won't decide for you — you still pick the plan.
title_en: Settle the plan with you before writing any code
